summary.name: Tapetide
summary.one_liner: Tapetide is an MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients to Indian stock market data for about 8,000 NSE and BSE stocks.
use_cases: Research an Indian company's financials and peers
Screen NSE and BSE stocks on fundamental or technical filters
Track daily FII and DII institutional flows
Review NIFTY option chains and implied volatility
Check promoter pledges, credit ratings and filings
Review a saved portfolio and watchlist in conversation
summary.what_it_does: Tapetide exposes 48 MCP tools that let an AI assistant look up NSE and BSE companies, financials, shareholding patterns, technicals, corporate filings and earnings call summaries. It includes a screener built on 326 financial ratios and technical filters such as RSI, MACD and moving averages. It also provides FII/DII flows, index data for about 140 NSE indices, end-of-day index option chains with Greeks and open interest, and promoter pledge and credit-rating data. Users can read and update a Tapetide portfolio and watchlist through the assistant, though it does not place trades. The page states that data is not a live trading feed and that freshness depends on the dataset.
notable: 48 MCP tools covering screening, company research, flows, options, filings and historical data
Free plan with 50 successful tool calls per day and Google sign-in
Point-in-time tools for historical symbols, index membership and corporate adjustments
caveats: Free plan is limited to 50 successful tool calls per day, shared across connected apps; higher limits require a paid plan
Not a live trading feed; index option chains are end-of-day snapshots and freshness depends on the dataset
Claude may ask for per-tool approval repeatedly, and permissions reset after catalog updates
